entries.description: Added RoundRectangle method to PdfContentByte with Bezier corner arcs, radius clamping, and negative radius handling.
Added ScaleToFill method to Image class. Uses Math.Max ratio (vs ScaleToFit's Math.Min) and applies unconditionally (scales up or down).

Added 7 RoundRectangle tests (operators, curve count, line count, radius clamping, zero radius, start point, negative radius) and 5 ScaleToFill tests (scale up, scale down, exact fit, aspect ratio, asymmetric target).
S03_LinesAndShapes: Added 'Rounded' rectangle to Section 4 row. S05_Images: Added ScaleToFill mode (with clipping) alongside Stretch/ScaleToFit/ActualSize.
dotnet build succeeded with 0 warnings, 0 errors. dotnet test: Passed 507, Failed 0. All 10 samples passed.
Cross-provider verification with gemini-pro (1 round). Session review saved to session-reviews/session-001.md.
